gallery.title: File:Kambula.jpg
gallery.description:
"The closing stages of the battle of Kambula. A company of the 1/13th in the foreground are driving the Zulus back into the ravine."
Author: Orlando Norie (1832-1901)

Source: Barthorp, Michael. The Zulu War: A Pictorial History.
